the localization technique for the IoT infrastructure is classified based on the presence of offline training.

In summary, our research is concerned with

the following aspects: 1) a review of the existing research on the localization techniques in IoT; 2) an analysis of the existing localization techniques; 3) a taxonomy of the localization techniques based on the presence of offline training; 4) a comparison of open research issues related with localization techniques in IoT.

the location of things (LoT) is a promising technology and has a bright future in the field of IoT.
localization techniques for WSNs and IoT have been extensively researched and are still evolving.
there are many challenges in developing the localization techniques for IoT applications.

the localization techniques for IoT are still in its infancy, so the research community needs to focus on the development of new localization algorithms for IoT.
we have provided a detailed analysis on the localization techniques and its application in different context.
we have presented a survey of localization techniques in the context of IoT infrastructure, and have also presented a comprehensive taxonomy of localization schemes for the IoT infrastructure.

the proposed taxonomy is useful for understanding the various aspects of localization techniques for IoT.
the existing localization techniques are not suitable for IoT infrastructure and there is a need to develop novel localization techniques for IoT infrastructure.
